label: Feet + gait documented together
significance: Bilateral foot pain and abnormal gait are already one presenting problem.

label: Neurology referral framed as gait + feet + muscle tension
significance: The integrated referral question is explicit before admission; there is not yet an already-posed feet-versus-neurology relationship.

label: Marked bilateral leg tone
significance: Pathological tone joins the gait/feet problem before Neurology.

label: Dystonic-looking lower-limb phenomenon documented
significance: Neurology observes a lower-limb phenomenon suggestive of dystonic posture while also holding the structural-foot findings.

label: Pre-Protest state: incompletely examined phenotype
significance: The surviving record does not identify a substantial neurological remapping of the feet after the neurological discoveries and before closure.

label: Established Protest: 'you cannot be finished'
significance: The patient challenges unfinished work: the feet have not been properly dealt with. He is not contesting a separation he already understands; he is forcing the clinical status of the feet into view.

label: Neurologist answers Podiatry; no neurological reopening identified
significance: Before the Protest the problem may be omission; after the Protest it becomes decision. The record identifies no defined neurological handover question or return mechanism.

label: Discharge synthesis constructs separate-or-neuropathic foot channel
significance: The synthesis preserves dystonic and foot facts but allocates the painful feet principally to 'completely separate' / peripheral-neuropathy / 'Not clear' / Podiatry territory while PRKN/Parkinsonism remains a different explanatory construction.

label: Patient-derived separation strengthened; Protest omitted
significance: 'Markedly divorced' and compatible understanding/plan language travel; the patient's warning that the phenotype was unfinished does not.

label: Procyclidine withdrawal boundary test
significance: Treatment state alters gait, tension and feet together, testing the newly durable partition.

label: GP reconnects feet with tone/gait/Parkinson's
significance: Primary care regenerates the integrated formulation.

label: Letters described as creating shared understanding
significance: The longitudinal letters are explicitly instruments of communicated interpretation.

label: Pain + shuffling described as OFF-related
significance: Later treatment-state evidence crosses the 2017 partition.

label: Urgent referral for severe bilateral foot/lower-leg pain
significance: Primary care again links severe pain to the longitudinal Parkinsonian control history.

label: Feet improve when Sinemet acts; CR introduced
significance: The feet are directly documented as changing with dopaminergic treatment state.

label: Historical pathway challenged
significance: The complaint asks why the model was not revisited earlier.

label: Historical letters invoked; profound CR relief accepted
significance: Documentary continuity and shared-understanding language are offered as part of the answer to the historical challenge.
